scope: Exact finite symbolic identities only. This run does not certify the external one-well theorem, actual conditional concentration, compact elliptic estimates, the finite-flow limiting argument, or the complete all-fiber M10 estimate.

checks.name: haar_radial_divergence
checks.statement: SU(2) radial Haar divergence is z'(r)+2 cot(r) z(r).

checks.name: haar_euler_origin
checks.statement: The three-dimensional Euler field has Haar divergence tending to 3.

checks.name: constrained_minimum_path_value
checks.statement: The stated constrained path has V=16[1-cos(theta/4)].

checks.name: constrained_antipode
checks.statement: The antipodal constrained value is 16-8 sqrt(2).

checks.name: potential_small_angle
checks.statement: v_min(theta)=theta^2/2+O(theta^4).

checks.name: agmon_phase_eikonal
checks.statement: I(0)=0 and I'(theta)^2=v_min(theta).

checks.name: agmon_small_angle
checks.statement: I(theta)=sqrt(2) theta^2/4+O(theta^4).

checks.name: trace_cometric_factor
checks.statement: Gamma(w,w)=2(1-w^2) implies Gamma(theta,theta)=2 on regular fibers.

checks.name: horizontal_lift_and_metric_speed
checks.statement: The constrained path is half the theta gradient and has G-speed squared 1/2.

checks.name: actual_gaussian_riccati
checks.statement: The stated actual-square precision satisfies A C A=M.

checks.name: conditional_gaussian_mean
checks.statement: At fixed q, the Gaussian minimum is (q/4,q/4,q/2).

checks.name: conditional_hessian_positive
checks.statement: All three leading principal minors of the one-color fast Hessian are positive.

checks.name: conditional_quadratic_form_S7
checks.statement: S7 equals one half the conditional Hessian quadratic form, per color.

checks.name: normal_drift_gaussian_coefficient
checks.statement: Both Gaussian variance formulas give (6+sqrt(6))|q|^2/48 for the stopped-Q drift.

checks.name: gaussian_retained_phase
checks.statement: The retained Gaussian phase matches I(|q|/2) at quadratic order.

checks.name: synchronized_cutoff_velocities
checks.statement: The four synchronized profiles preserve the complete minimum curve exactly.

checks.name: shifted_gaussian_skew_score
checks.statement: Euler dilation with its skew half-density term gives sigma=-a m(x-m)/g^3.

checks.name: shifted_gaussian_score_variance
checks.statement: The normalized squared-ground density gives Var(sigma)=a m^2/(2g^4).

checks.name: conditional_score_continuity_residual
checks.statement: Twice the score minus its coarse scalar is r/p; conditional normalization centers it.
